info.title: Access Gate integration API
info.description: Opt-in integration API for single-use code generation, encrypted creation replay and credential-owned status/revocation. Existing installations default to disabled. Credentials do not grant browser/admin access; source CIDRs and separate scopes apply. Specification version is independent of the installed application version.

servers.description: Example only. Replace the origin with the configured canonical HTTPS portal origin; keep /api/v1.

post.description: Requires batches:create. Apply defaults before fingerprinting, trim name and normalize equivalent duration units to seconds. A retry key is scoped to credential ID and this operation. Authentication grants no browsing or browser-admin access. All codes cover the current global restricted-domain list. See REST_API.md for replay, validation and error ordering.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for one intended generation operation. Reuse only for retries of the same normalized request. Never use a bearer token or visitor code here.

requestBody.description: One JSON object, UTF-8, no Content-Encoding, maximum 16384 bytes. All fields optional; an explicit empty object uses the documented defaults.

201.description: Created once, or replayed with the same 201 status during the 24-hour replay window. Only request_id changes on replay.

get.description: Owned resources only. Unknown and non-owned resources return the same 404. No raw codes, visitor IPs, browser cookies or browsing history.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque signed cursor bound to credential, collection, parent batch and page size. Use the same page size on subsequent pages.

200.description: Successful owned-resource result. Revocation is safe to repeat.

name.description: Trimmed by the server. Empty/whitespace uses the existing generated batch name; length is checked before trimming.

UtcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, ending in Z.

code.description: Secret single-use visitor code; never include in logs or ordinary read responses.

portal_url.description: Configured canonical portal root; never a visitor-code URL.

RequestId.description: Server-generated request identifier. Matches body request_id; changes on each attempt.

Replayed.description: false on initial creation; true on authenticated replay.

RetryAfter.description: Minimum seconds before another attempt. Retry with the same key and payload.

Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge; does not disclose credential validity details.

Allow.description: GET on read resources; POST on revocation resources; GET, POST on /batches.

integrationBearer.description: Independent integration credential issued by an administrator (#46). Required scope is declared by each operation. Never use browser cookies, the admin password, internal ACL keys or gateway credentials.

Error400.description: Bad request; invalid JSON (including duplicate keys/non-finite numbers), fields, host/transport or retry key.

Error401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or revoked bearer credential. No login redirect.

error.message: A valid integration credential is required.

Error403.description: Credential lacks batches:create or the effective source is not allowed.

error.message: This integration is not permitted to create batches.

Error404.description: API disabled or unknown API resource.

error.message: The requested API resource was not found.

Error405.description: Unsupported method on the batch creation resource.

Error409.description: Retry key conflicts with input or its secret replay payload has expired. No new batch is created.

error.message: This retry key was used with a different request.
The original codes are no longer available for replay.

Error413.description: Body exceeds 16384 bytes; the edge must use the same JSON envelope.

error.message: The request body is too large.

Error415.description: Content-Type is not application/json or uses an unsupported charset/content encoding.

Error429.description: A source, credential or global budget is exhausted. No new batch is created.

error.message: The API request limit was reached.

Error500.description: Unexpected server failure. Never include exception text or secrets.

error.message: The API could not complete this request.

Error503.description: Temporarily unavailable, including locked storage or unavailable replay decryption. Never create a replacement batch.

Errordefault.description: Other HTTP failures inside the configured API edge use the same JSON error envelope. TLS/network failures have no API envelope.

x-pagination-convention.status: implemented; codes use descending identifier order because batch codes share a creation time
